0022600206.text: The Toronto Raptors (5-4, 2-1 at home) sit sixth in the East and 2.5 games back in the Atlantic, while the visiting Memphis Grizzlies (6-3, 4-0 on the road) are third in the Southwest, one game back, and seventh in the West, though they have lost three straight. Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), and Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Memphis is missing Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise), Richie Saunders (knee surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Raptors won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 128-96 in Memphis on April 3, 2026.
